kill_switch: OPERATOR_TURN_MEMORY_ENABLED=true (exact string; default off; not pinned anywhere)

operator_turn.hook: routes/operator.ts after processWithGemini — fire-and-forget, off the reply's critical path
operator_turn.skip: no model call when the user text or reply is empty, or the reply is < 160 chars with no tool call
operator_turn.never: task_outcome (owned by VTID-03928's tool-outcome writer and by the executor)

write.vtid: from the item, the text, or the route's validated VTID
write.content_suffix: (Operator Console thread <8 chars>, extracted from the turn by VTID-04025.)

executor_run.hook: dev-autopilot-execute.ts applyExecutionResult — after the OASIS event on both branches, fire-and-forget

failed.content: the failure reason (carries the W0 CI log excerpt when the failure came from CI)

failure_posture: fail-open: extractor/router/write failures are logged and never reach the reply or the execution row
next_signal: [operator-turn-memory] thread …: N memory row(s) written in the staging gateway log; turn-extracted rows in dev_agent_memory
